messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Dress the person in the complete outfit shown from the front and back in the reference images, consisting of the top and the bottoms. This replaces the current outfit entirely, rather than adding items to it. Preserve everything else in the video. Remove the current footwear and leave the person barefoot. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Dress the person in the complete outfit shown from the front and back in the reference images, consisting of the top and the bottoms. This replaces the current outfit entirely, rather than adding items to it. Preserve everything else in the video. Remove the current footwear and leave the person barefoot. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character dances, starting with a wide stance and arm movements, then turning her body and raising her arms before settling into a standing pose facing the camera.","camera":"The camera starts with a full-body shot and gradually zooms in to a medium close-up of the upper body and face.","clothing":"A white sleeveless halter top with a red and green floral pattern, paired with olive-green capri pants and a dark belt.","hair_color":"White.","hairstyle":"White hair styled in a high ponytail with straight bangs across the forehead.","identity":"A 3D-rendered young woman with a slim build, fair skin, and a neutral facial expression.","scene":"A dimly lit, narrow alleyway at night, decorated with hanging red lanterns and red triangular pennant flags, with neon signs and brick walls in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character now wears a white sleeveless halter top with red/green floral pattern and olive-green capri pants with a dark waistband. The red sneakers are gone and the character appears barefoot. The dance, camera zoom, alley scene, hair, and character identity remain largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's current outfit entirely with the reference outfit: white floral halter top and olive/khaki capri pants, and remove footwear so the person is barefoot while preserving the rest of the video.
uncertain: Exact back-view fit of the pants and top could not be fully verified from the available frames.
